title: San Francisco sues Trump Media & Technology, claiming its Truth API service violates California's Unfair Competition Law by creating an insider trading market (Heather Knight/New York Times)
summary: Heather Knight / New York Times: San Francisco sues Trump Media & Technology, claiming its Truth API service violates California's Unfair Competition Law by creating an insider trading market — The city attorney argued that the service, available for up to $100,000 a month, could allow wealthy traders to manipulate the market …
